authority: Owner ruling D4 (CR-09): every declared capability requires a reviewed capability-to-producer record; an empty signal list is never emitted as exhaustive evidence. Source: simkit/handoffs/completion-20261012/decisions/OWNER-RULINGS.json.
base: controller 0e862c8 (feat/simkit-completion-snowyowl); line numbers refer to that base
gate_rule: A capability with d4_gated=true is declared by WeatherAdapter.implemented_capabilities() only when its method exists, status is PRODUCER_MAPPED and reviewer is a non-empty string. reviewer/reviewed_at are left null for the coordinator. PARTIAL and NOT_DECLARED records can never be declared by review alone: the status must change with new producers.
